final: WITH rebate_groups AS (SELECT f.orderslink AS fee_order_reference, o.ordertune AS order_type, AVG(f.rebtotal) AS avg_total_rebate_usd, AVG((f.rebrate - f.feerate) / NULLIF(f.feerate, 0)) AS avg_rate_expression FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink COLLATE BINARY = o.recordvault COLLATE BINARY WHERE f.feecoin = 'USD' GROUP BY f.orderslink COLLATE BINARY, o.ordertune), group_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_total_rebate_usd) AS value FROM rebate_groups) SELECT g.fee_order_reference, g.order_type, g.avg_total_rebate_usd, g.avg_rate_expression, g.avg_total_rebate_usd - a.value AS rebate_difference FROM rebate_groups AS g CROSS JOIN group_average AS a WHERE g.avg_total_rebate_usd > a.value ORDER BY rebate_difference DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
